meaning:
κατα-καυχάομαι, -ῶμαι
[in LXX: Zec.10:12 (הָלַךְ hith.), Jer.50:11 (עָלַז), Jer.50:38 (הָלַל)* ;]
1. to boast against, exult over: with genitive, Rom.11:18, Jas.2:13; before κατά, with genitive, Jas.3:14 (T, om. κατά).
2. before ἐν, to glory in (Za., l.with, Jer.27:38).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.
For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
